searchText: looks like we finalized devnet 4 Awesome 👏 just in time for BPO5 too we are pumping the blob throughput a bit up there are random blocks now with up to 72 blobs Devnet 4 will most likely not be sufficient for us to have proper BPO analysis done, so that will have to wait for the next devnet. But we can still repurpose it for a performance test. Boom https://dora.fusaka-devnet-4.ethpandaops.io/slot/50927 Gonna add some extra gas in the txs and gonna make them a bit bigger too, with some zero byte data The size for a Prysm super node of data column sidecars storage for such a block with 72 blobs. new transaction graph on spamoor shows that we are really cooking now also looks like cooking might be a bit too much 😄 100M gas tx with 5MB block and 72 blob 😂 Are you also testing running validators in separate validator clients, or only running validators directly inside CL clients? I think this could make a (probably small) difference, but a large part of ETH mainnet runs with separate validator clients so would probably be good to take it into account. The larger these blocks get, the larger the difference would also get. Any plans to send 48 blobs/block on average? 😄 in hindsight those were actually canonical and it seems like the it was the `nimbus-besu-super-1` node that had problems we use the default for all client. So teku built in, lighthouse separate etc. yup we can see that nimbus is really struggling to keep up some nimbus nodes seem to be on a diff fork are we still planning to test the mev pipeline on this devnet? we most certainly can try setting it up now For blocks we have strategy which tries to get all forks especially when failed to retrieve one For supplemental sidecars, yeah you are right we try to request it from all connected peers filtering only by custody requirements and throttling limits, so we don't know if this peer has this fork when requesting sidecars. I've cleaned up some nodes that seemed to have been stuck syncing, and starting with a fresh db. Hopefully once all those peers come back online, we gonna have a very healthy chain The TL;DR is for data column sidecars we make a map from peer to supposed custody columns for each needed root. We select one peer randomly, try to fetch columns. We remove the peer from the map and if still some sidecars are missing after requesting this peer, we try an other one etc... After making a whole iteration, if sidecars are still missing but we have enough to reconstruct, we reconstruct. enabling mev boost on 80% supernodes unfortunately was not able to get the builder to register to the relay for some reason, so we couldn’t test out the mev workflow on devnet 4. we gonna be shutting down devnet 4 in the next few hours. As it’s a massive network, likely not many eyes gonna be on it throughout the weekend. We definitely going to have a devnet 5 tho very shortly, probably as soon as next friday. Ideally that’s gonna be as stable as one can wish for. while terraform destory is running I've managed to get the mev relay working again and we immediately started seeing some mev blocks coming in 🔥

excerpts.author: dmitriishmatko
excerpts.content:
For blocks we have strategy which tries to get all forks especially when failed to retrieve one
For supplemental sidecars, yeah you are right we try to request it from all connected peers filtering only by custody requirements and throttling limits, so we don't know if this peer has this fork when requesting sidecars.

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: I've cleaned up some nodes that seemed to have been stuck syncing, and starting with a fresh db. Hopefully once all those peers come back online, we gonna have a very healthy chain

excerpts.author: manunlp
excerpts.content:
The TL;DR is for data column sidecars we make a map from peer to supposed custody columns for each needed root.
We select one peer randomly, try to fetch columns. We remove the peer from the map and if still some sidecars are missing after requesting this peer, we try an other one etc...

After making a whole iteration, if sidecars are still missing but we have enough to reconstruct, we reconstruct.
